title: Donut SMP Modpack
description: Donut SMP-inspired optimized modpack with FPS boosts, voice chat, minimap, and multiplayer quality-of-life mods for smooth PvP and survival gameplay.
body:
# ⚡ **Donut SMP Optimized Client**

_A lightweight Minecraft client focused on maximum FPS, smooth PvP gameplay, and essential SMP utilities. Built for Donut SMP-style servers with performance-first design and clean vanilla-friendly improvements._

**🚀 Performance Boost**
 - ⚡ High FPS optimizations
 - 🧠 Reduced memory usage
 - 🌍 Faster chunk loading
 - 🔥 Entity + block culling
 - 📉 Reduced lag spikes & stutters
  
**🎮 Multiplayer Features**
 - 🧭 Minimap + World Map support
 - 🎤 Proximity Voice Chat
 - 🖥️ ViaFabricPlus play at any server including Bedrock
 - 🔍 Smooth zoom for PvP & exploration
 - 📦 Shulker box previews
 - 🛡️ Armor HUD improvements
 - 🧊 Litematica Mod
 - 🖥️ Borderless fullscreen support
  
**🎨 Visual Enhancements**
 - 🌿 Better grass & terrain visuals
 - 💡 Dynamic lighting
 - 🌌 Improved skies & ambience
 - ✨ Connected textures
 - 🎥 Screenshot tools + freelook camera
 - 🧊 Bobby for more chunks in servers

**⚙️ Optimization Mods (Core)**
 - Sodium
 - Lithium
 - FerriteCore
 - ImmediatelyFast
 - C2ME
 - EntityCulling
 - Krypton
 - Dynamic FPS
  
**🧩 Utility Mods**
 - Xaero's Minimap
 - Xaero's World Map
 - Simple Voice Chat
 - Zoomify
 - ShulkerBoxTooltip
 - Armor HUD
 - Mod Menu
